descriptor.determiners: priors.js DEFINITE_DETERMINERS + INDEFINITE_DETERMINERS (giver lang/en, the-fold P41)
descriptor.posPriorGate: hypergraph.js::makeRelationReader posPriorFor -> relations.js::discoverRelationVocab's own posPrior param (giver UD_English-EWT, CC BY-SA 4.0) — TYPE-level vocabulary gate: verbShare > 0.5 across attested uses admits, an unattested form is NOT refused, ACTIVE at vocabulary discovery (before extractRelations runs)
descriptor.classifyConnector: wordclass.js dominantClass (giver UD_English-EWT, CC BY-SA 4.0) — minShare 0.5, per-EDGE DISCLOSURE ONLY, never gates admission (see posPriorGate above for the vocabulary-level gate, which is a different mechanism and IS active)

spans.text: Source: MasakhaNER 2.0 (Nigerian Pidgin / Naija, "pcm" split) Fetched directly from: https://github.com/masakhane-io/masakhane-ner (MasakhaNER2.0/data/pcm/{train,dev,test}.txt) This is the exact dataset CreoleVal's own nlu/ner/download_masakhaner.sh script fetches -- CreoleVal does not vendor the raw text in-repo, only the download script and MaChAmp training configs (nlu/ner/configs/ner_naija.json), so this pocket fetched the real upstream files directly, the same way CreoleVal's own script would.
